QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] What's Under the Animal Costume? 1
QuestInfo.1: According to #p2152009#, no one has ever seen the face of #b#p2152005# the part-timer#k, because he always wears a bear suit while handing out fliers at the Square Fountain. #p2152009# says her curiosity is driving her crazy...
QuestInfo.2: #p2152005# scribbled something on a piece of paper for you. It said, #b'Inside is a dream and a hope'#k... You doubted #p2152009# would be pleased with that answer...

0.0: Hey, did you see the guy in front of the fountain? The guy in the bear costume? His name is #p2152005# and no one's ever seen his real face!
0.1: They say he never takes off his suit, even when he's sleeping! Doesn't that make you wonder who he really is?

yes.0: Who WOULDN'T be curious, right? So let's do some digging and try to find out who #p2152005# REALLY is, yeah? First, you go ask him. He didn't answer when I asked, but maybe you'll have better luck.
yes.1: If he tells you, you HAVE to tell me!

no.0: I can't believe you're not curious. I had a dream about #p2152005# last night. In it, he removed his mask and underneath it was...another mask! I woke up with shivers.

1.0: Can I help you? No pictures, please. \r\n(You ask him who he is under the bear costume.) \r\nWhat are you talking about? This bear costume is filled with #b<Hopes and Dreams>#k!

yes.0: Please stop asking silly questions. Why are people like #p2152009# so curious about me?

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #b#p2152005##k yet? He's the one passing out the fliers in #bfront of the fountain#k. It's really hard to miss his #bbear costume#k.
